shell_side_panel_unknown_description: This version of Mannie has no panel of the kind {kind}.
markdown_copy_failed: Copying failed. Select the code and copy it yourself.

markdown_link_too_long: This link is longer than {maxBytes} bytes, so Mannie does not open it.
markdown_link_open_failed: The browser could not be opened. Check that your system has a default browser, then try again.

chat_error_too_many_images: A message holds at most {max: number} images. Remove some images, then send again.
chat_error_image_unavailable: An image of this message can no longer be sent, because the plugin that added it is off. Remove the image, then send again.
chat_error_image_refused: Mannie could not send an image of this message. {reason} Remove the image, then add it again.
chat_profile_menu_label: Provider profile for the next replies
chat_context_unknown_details: Mannie measures the context with the first reply.
chat_context_estimated: This is an estimate. The provider's token counts replace it after the next reply.
chat_reasoning_hidden: The model reasoned before it answered.
chat_status_compacting: Summarizing older messages for the model…
chat_status_output_limit: The reply stopped at the profile's output limit.
chat_status_content_filter: The provider's content filter ended the reply.
chat_status_prompt_cut: The server may have left out the start of this conversation: it reported a shorter request than Mannie sent. Set the model's context size on the server to the profile's context window, or lower the profile's context window.
chat_status_interrupted: Mannie quit before this reply finished.
chat_rename_description: The new title shows in the sidebar and in the window's title.
chat_delete_description: "{title}" and all its messages are deleted. A reply that is being written stops. This cannot be undone.
chat_project_rename_description: The name shows in the sidebar. The folder stays as it is.

match.countPlural=one: "{project}" and its conversation are removed, with the conversation's history. The folder and its files stay as they are. This cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=other: "{project}" and its {count: number} conversations are removed, with their history. The folder and its files stay as they are. This cannot be undone.

chat_project_remove_description_empty: "{project}" is removed. It has no conversations, and the folder and its files stay as they are.
chat_project_path_title: Add a project from a path
chat_project_path_description: Type the full path of a folder. Mannie checks that it exists, and the folder becomes a project.
chat_failure_invalid_credential: The provider refused the API key. Check the profile's API key in the provider settings.
chat_failure_permission_denied: The API key has no permission for this model or request. Check the account's access at the provider.
chat_failure_quota_exceeded: The account's quota at the provider is used up. Check the account's plan or billing.
chat_failure_model_not_found: The server does not know the model {model}. Check the model name in the provider settings.
chat_failure_endpoint_not_found: The server has no such endpoint. Check the base URL and the API interface in the provider settings.
chat_failure_rate_limited: The provider limits the request rate. Try again later.
chat_failure_rate_limited_until: The provider limits the request rate. Try again after {time}.
chat_failure_server_error: The server failed with status {status}. Try again later.
chat_failure_context_overflow: The conversation is longer than the model's context, even after summarizing. Start a new conversation or use a model with a larger context window.
chat_failure_request_too_large: The latest message alone does not fit into the model's context. Shorten it, or use a model with a larger context window.
chat_failure_bad_request: The server refused the request with status {status}. Check the profile's model, limits and reasoning effort.
chat_failure_content_filtered: The provider's content filter refused the request or the reply.
chat_failure_connection_failed: The server could not be reached. Check the base URL and the network connection.
chat_failure_timed_out: The server did not answer in time.
chat_failure_tools_unsupported: The server refused the request because of its tools. The model or the server may not support tools. Turn off "Use tools" in the provider profile to chat without them.
chat_failure_broken_stream: The reply stopped before it was complete.
chat_failure_invalid_response: The server sent an answer that Mannie could not read. Check that the API interface matches the server.
chat_failure_redirect_refused: The server answered with a redirect, which Mannie does not follow. Check the base URL.
chat_failure_credential_missing: The profile's API key is missing from the credential store. Enter it again in the provider settings.
chat_failure_credential_store_unavailabl: The credential store could not be read. Unlock it, then retry.
chat_failure_profile_missing: The provider profile of this reply no longer exists. Choose another profile, then retry.
chat_failure_no_profile: No provider profile exists. Add one in the provider settings.
chat_failure_internal: Mannie failed while writing this reply. Retry, and report the problem with the log file if it happens again.
chat_failure_lease_revoked: Mannie took back the provider's credential of this task, so the reply stopped.
chat_error_message_too_long: The message is longer than {maxBytes} bytes. Shorten it.
chat_error_title_too_long: The title is longer than {maxCharacters} characters.
chat_error_instructions_too_long: The instructions are longer than {maxBytes} bytes. Shorten them.
chat_error_instructions_too_many_charact: The instructions are longer than {maxCharacters} characters. Shorten them.
chat_error_run_active: A reply is being written in this conversation. Wait for it or stop it first.
chat_error_nothing_to_retry: The latest reply did not fail, stop or get interrupted, so there is nothing to retry.
chat_error_nothing_to_compact: There are not enough earlier messages to summarize yet.
chat_error_compacting: The conversation is being summarized. Try again when it is done.
chat_error_compaction_failed: The summary could not be written. {cause}
chat_error_profile_not_found: The provider profile no longer exists.
chat_error_project_not_found: The project does not exist any more.
chat_error_project_name_invalid: A project's name has 1 to {maxCharacters} characters.
chat_error_project_busy: A conversation of this project is starting a reply or being compacted. Try again when it is done.

match.countPlural=one: The project has 1 conversation now. Check the number, then remove it again.
match.countPlural=other: The project has {count: number} conversations now. Check the number, then remove it again.

chat_error_path_refused: Mannie does not accept this folder. {reason}
chat_error_not_a_folder: The path is not a folder.
chat_error_folder_unreadable: Mannie could not open the folder. Check that you have access to it.
chat_error_folder_dialog_failed: The folder dialog could not be opened. Type the path instead.
chat_folder_refusal_empty: The path is empty or contains a control character.
chat_folder_refusal_alternate_stream: Alternate data streams are not allowed.
chat_folder_refusal_reserved_name: The path contains a name that Windows reserves for devices, such as CON or COM1.
chat_folder_refusal_trailing_dot_or_spac: A name in the path ends with a dot or a space.
chat_folder_refusal_drive_relative: The path is relative to the current folder of a drive.
chat_folder_refusal_not_absolute: The path is not a full path.
chat_error_written_by_newer_version: A newer version of Mannie wrote these settings, so this version does not change them.
chat_error_storage_failed: The conversation could not be read or saved. Restart Mannie, and report the problem with the log file if it happens again.
chat_error_shutting_down: Mannie is quitting and starts no more replies.

chat_error_task_target_unreachable: {target} cannot be reached. Check that it runs and that this computer reaches it, then try again.
chat_error_task_unreachable: Where this task runs cannot be reached. Check that it runs and that this computer reaches it, then try again.
chat_error_plugin_off: The {plugin} plugin is off. Turn it on in the Plugins settings, then try again.
chat_instructions_section_description: Instructions that apply to every conversation, from its next reply on.
chat_providers_section_description: The servers and models that write the replies. API keys stay in the system's credential store.
chat_providers_empty_description: A profile names one model on one server, such as OpenAI or a local server.
chat_providers_dialog_description: Mannie checks the fields when you save, and keeps the API key in the system's credential store.
chat_providers_delete_description: "{name}" and its API key are deleted. Conversations that used it switch to the default profile.
chat_providers_field_interface_descripti: OpenAI's models use the Responses API. Most other servers use Chat Completions.
chat_providers_field_base_url_descriptio: The address that ends before /responses or /chat/completions.
chat_providers_defaults_applied: Mannie knows this model and filled in its limits.
chat_providers_field_credential_descript: Leave it empty if the server needs no key. Over plain HTTP, Mannie sends a key only to this computer or to a private network address.
chat_providers_field_credential_saved_de: Remove the key if the server needs none. Over plain HTTP, Mannie sends a key only to this computer or to a private network address.
chat_providers_credential_saved_placehol: A key is saved. Type a new key to replace it.
chat_providers_credential_remove_warning: Saving removes the saved key. The profile then sends no key.
chat_providers_field_effort_description: How much the model reasons before it answers. With the server's default, Mannie sends no effort setting.
chat_providers_field_use_tools_descripti: The model can read and change files and run commands on this computer, with your approval. Turn this off for models that cannot call tools.
chat_providers_limits_required: Enter the context window, at least {minContextWindow} tokens, and the output limit, at least {minOutputLimit} tokens.
chat_providers_error_invalid_name: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
chat_providers_error_name_taken: Another profile already has this name.
chat_providers_error_invalid_base_url: Enter an http or https address without user name, query or fragment.
chat_providers_error_insecure_credential: Over plain HTTP, Mannie sends an API key only to this computer or to a private network address. Use https for this server, or remove the key.
chat_providers_error_invalid_model: Enter a model name of up to 200 characters.
chat_providers_error_invalid_limits: The context window must be between {minContextWindow} and {maxContextWindow} tokens, and leave at least {minBudget} tokens after the output limit.
chat_providers_error_invalid_credential: The API key is empty or too long, or it contains characters that a request cannot carry.
chat_providers_error_profile_in_use: A reply that is being written uses this profile. Delete it after the reply ends.
chat_providers_error_storage_failed: The profile could not be read or saved. Restart Mannie, and report the problem with the log file if it happens again.
chat_providers_store_no_secret_service: No credential store is running. On Linux, start GNOME Keyring or KWallet, then try again. Profiles without an API key still work.
chat_providers_store_unsupported_platfor: This system has no credential store that Mannie can use, so Mannie cannot save API keys. Profiles without a key still work.
chat_providers_store_access_denied: The credential store refused access. Unlock it, then try again.
chat_providers_store_other: The credential store failed. Try again, and report the problem with the log file if it happens again.
chat_providers_test_description: Mannie checks the API key, lists the server's models, and asks the model for a short reply.
chat_providers_note_model_not_listed: The server does not list this model. It may still answer, but check the model name.
chat_providers_note_model_list_unavailab: The server does not list its models, so the model name could not be checked.
chat_providers_note_no_usage_reported: The server reported no token counts. Mannie estimates the context instead, which is less exact.
chat_providers_note_no_reasoning_returne: The server accepted the reasoning effort but returned no reasoning.
chat_providers_note_no_tool_call: The model answered without calling the tool it was asked to call, so it may not use tools reliably.
chat_providers_skip_no_credential: Skipped because the profile has no API key.
chat_providers_skip_earlier_check_failed: Skipped because an earlier check failed.
chat_providers_skip_no_model_list: Skipped because the server lists no models.
chat_providers_skip_no_reasoning_effort: Skipped because the profile sets no reasoning effort.
chat_providers_skip_tools_off: Skipped because the profile does not use tools.
chat_providers_test_reported_limits: The server reports a context window of {window} tokens and an output limit of {limit} tokens.
chat_providers_test_reported_window: The server reports a context window of {window} tokens.
chat_providers_test_limits_applied: The profile uses these limits now.
window_close_question_title: What should closing the window do?
window_close_question_description: In the system tray, Mannie keeps running and replies continue, and the tray icon opens the window again. Mannie remembers your choice, and you can change it in the settings.

match.countPlural=other: {count: number} replies are being written. Quitting interrupts them, and you can retry them after Mannie starts again.

window_quit_warning_title: Quit while replies are being written?

window_settings_description: What happens when you close Mannie's window.
window_settings_close_ask_description: Mannie asks once and remembers the answer.
window_settings_close_tray: Keep running in the system tray
window_settings_close_tray_description: Replies continue, and the tray icon opens the window again.
window_settings_close_quit_description: While replies are being written, Mannie asks first.
window_settings_load_failed_title: The window settings could not be read
window_error_invalid_label: A label of the tray menu is not valid.
window_error_request_not_pending: This question was already answered or withdrawn.
tools_settings_description: What runs without asking, the rules for commands, and the permissions beyond one conversation.
tools_command_show_permissions: Show the permissions of this conversation
tools_full_access_confirm_description: Every command and change of this conversation and its child agents will run without asking you, anywhere on this computer, Mannie's own files included. Tasks that run on other computers will also run their requests without asking you, unless those computers' settings refuse that. Text that the model reads can make it run commands that you would not allow.
tools_full_access_on_failed_title: Full access could not be turned on
tools_full_access_off_failed_title: Full access could not be turned off
tools_tool_file_info: Read the details of a path
tools_done_read: Read {path}, lines {first: number} to {last: number} of {total: number}
tools_done_command_timed_out: Ran {command}: ended by its timeout after {duration}
tools_done_output_read: Read lines {first: number} to {last: number} of an archived output
tools_canceled_description: The reply stopped before this ran.
tools_denied_description: The model was told that you denied it.
tools_uncertain_description: Mannie quit while this ran, so it may have taken effect. Check the result before you run it again.
tools_uncertain_stopped_description: You stopped the reply while this ran, so it may have taken effect. Check the result before you run it again.
tools_uncertain_plugin_off_description: The {plugin} plugin was turned off while this ran, so it may have taken effect. Check the result before you run it again.
tools_not_run_unknown_tool: The model called a tool that does not exist.
tools_not_run_invalid_arguments: The model's arguments do not fit the tool. The model was told what is wrong.
tools_not_run_cut_off: The reply reached its output limit before the call was complete.
tools_not_run_earlier_call_denied: You denied an earlier call of the same step, so this one did not run.
tools_not_run_over_budget: The reply used up its tool calls.
tools_not_run_tools_off: The provider profile does not use tools.
tools_not_run_plugin_off: The {plugin} plugin was turned off after the reply started, so this did not run.
tools_refusal_read_only_host: The computer that runs this task only reads and searches, so it refused this.
tools_refusal_no_projects_on_host: The computer that runs this task has no projects to move a conversation into.
tools_refusal_no_remote_commands: The computer that runs this task runs no commands on other computers.
tools_refusal_no_programs_on_host: The computer that runs this task runs no plugin's programs.
tools_details_arguments_cut: The arguments are longer than shown here.
tools_access_project: Move this conversation to the project {project}

match.countPlural=one: Discards 1 commit that no other branch holds
match.countPlural=other: Discards {count: number} commits that no other branch holds

match.countPlural=one: Rewrites 1 commit that is already on {places}
match.countPlural=other: Rewrites {count: number} commits that are already on {places}

tools_effect_key_rewrites_published: rewrites commits that are already on a remote branch

tools_decision_always_grant: A permission for every conversation allowed this.
tools_decision_allowed_for_project: You allowed this for this project.
tools_decision_allowed_always: You allowed this for every conversation.
tools_decision_grant: A permission of this conversation allowed this.
tools_decision_allowed_for_conversation: You allowed this for the conversation.
tools_decision_rule_saved: You saved a rule and allowed this.
tools_decision_allowed_folder: An allowed folder of the computer that runs the task allowed this.
tools_decision_host_rule: A command rule of the computer that runs the task allowed this.
tools_decision_host_full_access: The full access of the computer that runs the task allowed this.

tools_reason_change_in_workspace: It changes the workspace, and the settings ask before changes.
tools_reason_mannie_folder: It reaches into Mannie's own data or logs.

tools_reason_move_to_project: Your message did not name this project, or another tool call came first.

tools_reason_host_asks: The settings of the computer that runs the task ask before this change or command.

tools_reason_program: It runs an installed program that does something beyond the workspace, and no rule or permission covers it.
tools_grant_program_effects: The run {run} in {folder}, also when it {effects}

tools_rule_limit_folder: Only in this folder and the folders inside it
tools_rule_remote_description: Commands that start with the words you choose then run without asking on this host, in every conversation. Commands with shell operators always ask.

tools_permissions_failed_title: The permissions could not be read

tools_settings_rules_description: Commands that start with a rule's words run without asking, in every conversation. Commands with shell operators always ask.
tools_settings_rules_failed_title: The rules could not be read
tools_settings_rule_in_folder: In {folder} and the folders inside it

tools_tool_read_command_output: Read the output of a background command

tools_background_panel_invalid: This panel names no command. Close it and open the output from the conversation.

tools_background_note_several: Commands {numbers} ended, and the agent continued
tools_settings_wake: Wake the agent when a background command ends

tools_error_approval_not_pending: This request no longer waits for a decision.
tools_error_approval_changed: The request changed while you decided. Check it again, then choose.
tools_error_rule_not_possible: A rule cannot cover this command, because it contains shell operators.
tools_error_rule_prefix_invalid: Choose how many of the command's words the rule keeps.
tools_error_not_in_a_project: This conversation belongs to no project.
tools_error_grant_not_possible: This operation can only be allowed once.
tools_error_environment_name_invalid: {name} is not a valid name for an environment variable.
tools_error_environment_name_secret: {name} looks like the name of a secret, which commands never receive.
tools_error_too_many_environment_names: Commands can receive at most {max: number} extra variables.
tools_error_written_by_newer_version: A newer version of Mannie saved these settings, so this version does not change them.
tools_error_storage_failed: Mannie could not read or save the data. The log has the cause.
tools_error_full_access_follows_parent: A task's conversation follows the full access of the conversation that gave the task.
tools_error_full_access_refused: The computer that runs this task does not let full access answer its requests, so this one waits for your decision.
tools_error_task_target_unreachable: {target} cannot be reached, so your decision did not reach it. Check that it runs, then try again.
tools_error_task_unreachable: Where this task runs cannot be reached, so your decision did not reach it. Check that it runs, then try again.
tools_error_plugin_off: The {plugin} plugin is off, so your decision did not reach the task. Turn the plugin on in the Plugins settings.
tools_path_refusal_empty: The path is empty or contains a control character.
tools_path_refusal_alternate_stream: Alternate data streams are not allowed.
tools_path_refusal_reserved_name: The path contains a name that Windows reserves for devices, such as CON or COM1.
tools_path_refusal_trailing_dot_or_space: A name in the path ends with a dot or a space.
tools_path_refusal_drive_relative: The path is relative to the current folder of a drive.
tools_path_refusal_not_absolute: The path is not a full path.
tools_failure_no_workspace: The conversation has no workspace, so relative paths and commands without a working directory cannot run.
tools_failure_already_in_project: This conversation already belongs to the project {project}.
tools_failure_path_through_link: The path goes through a link, so Mannie did not change it. The resolved path is {resolved}.
tools_failure_revision_mismatch: The file changed after the model read it.
tools_failure_edit_not_found: The text to replace in edit {edit: number} does not appear in the file.
tools_failure_edit_ambiguous: The text to replace in edit {edit: number} appears {matches: number} times.
tools_failure_edits_overlap: Edits {first: number} and {second: number} change the same text.
tools_failure_unsupported_encoding: {path} is not UTF-8 or UTF-16 text.
tools_failure_link_in_source: {path} is a link, which Mannie does not copy.
tools_failure_different_volume: The source and the destination are on different drives.
tools_failure_too_many_entries: There are more than {limit: number} entries.
tools_failure_output_not_found: The archived output does not exist in this conversation.
tools_failure_path_changed: The path changed after the call was allowed, so nothing was changed.
tools_failure_spawn_failed: The command could not be started.
tools_failure_plugin_invalid: The {plugin} plugin answered in a way that Mannie does not accept, so nothing ran.
child_agents_no_report: The child agent ended without a report.
child_agents_detached: Mannie stopped following this task. It may still run where it was given, and its conversation shows what happened since.
child_agents_refusal_budget_used: No task started: this reply has started all the tasks it may start.
child_agents_refusal_not_started: No task started: Mannie stopped before the task was stored.
child_agents_refusal_still_running: No task started: task {number} is still running.
child_agents_refusal_unknown_task: No task started: this conversation has no task {number}.
child_agents_refusal_plugin_off: No task started: the {plugin} plugin is off.
child_agents_call_untitled: A task for a child agent
child_agents_call_untitled_task: A task that a plugin runs
child_agents_call_canceled: No task started: the reply stopped first.
child_agents_settings_description: How many child agents work at the same time on this computer.
child_agents_settings_limit_description: When this many child agents work, further tasks wait for a free slot. A higher limit starts waiting tasks at once.
child_agents_error_storage_failed: The settings could not be read or saved. The log in Mannie's data folder has the cause. Try again, and restart Mannie if it keeps failing.
child_agents_error_written_by_newer_vers: A newer version of Mannie saved these settings, so this version cannot change them. Install the newer version to change them.
plugins_settings_description: Turn on the features that you use. A change takes effect at once.
plugins_list_failed_title: The plugins could not be loaded
plugins_empty: This version of Mannie has no plugins.
plugins_failure_grant_missing: The plugin asked for a service that its manifest does not declare. Report this as a bug.
plugins_failure_service_unavailable: Mannie could not give the plugin a service that it needs. Report this as a bug.
plugins_failure_sdk_incompatible: The plugin was built for another version of the plugin SDK. Report this as a bug.
plugins_failure_contributions_refused: Mannie refused what the plugin adds, such as a tool with the name of another one. Report this as a bug.
plugins_failure_other: The plugin reported the code {code}. The log has the cause.
plugins_use_commands: Commands that its window may call
plugins_use_channels: Channels that its window may follow
plugins_use_crates: Libraries that only it may use
plugins_use_service_store: Its own tables in Mannie's database
plugins_use_service_secrets: Its own entries in the credential store
plugins_use_service_credentials: Provider credentials, lent to its own tasks
plugins_use_service_executor_host: The tasks that conversations give it
plugins_use_service_processes: Installed programs that its manifest names, under your approvals
plugins_use_service_background_commands: Commands that keep running in the background, which Mannie follows and stops
plugins_change_failed_title: The change could not be made

match.countPlural=one: Its tools started a command in the background that still runs. Turning the plugin off stops it.
match.countPlural=other: Its tools started {count: number} commands in the background that still run. Turning the plugin off stops them.

plugins_error_unknown_plugin: This version of Mannie has no such plugin.
plugins_error_storage_failed: Mannie could not save your choice. Check the log, then try again.
plugins_error_store_unavailable: Mannie started without its database, so plugins cannot change.
plugins_host_plugin_off: {name} is off. Turn it on in Settings, Plugins, then try again.
plugins_host_store_unavailable: Mannie started without its database. Restart Mannie, and check the log if this happens again.
plugins_host_unknown_command: This version of {name} cannot do this. Report this as a bug.
plugins_host_invalid_input: {name} refused what the window sent. Report this as a bug.
plugins_host_input_too_large: This is too large for {name}, which accepts at most {limit} bytes at once.
plugins_host_host_service_failed: Mannie could not complete this. The log has the cause.
plugins_host_not_allowed: The window may not ask {name} for this. Report this as a bug.
plugins_off_part_description: This belongs to the {name} plugin. Turn it on in the Plugins settings to use it.
export_description: Save the conversation, child conversations, stored images and complete tool outputs in a new folder.
export_partial: The export is saved, with some content unavailable. The document lists every omission.
export_error_conversation_not_found: This conversation no longer exists. Open another conversation and try again.
export_error_storage_failed: The saved conversation or export journal could not be read or written. Check storage access and try again.
export_error_store_unavailable: The conversation store is unavailable. Restart Mannie and try again.
export_error_dialog_failed: The folder picker could not open. Check your desktop session and try again.
export_error_write_failed: The export folder could not be written. Check free space and folder permissions, then choose a destination again. Any folder marked incomplete is unfinished.
export_error_export_active: Another export is running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
export_error_unsupported: This task host does not support complete conversation export. Update it and try again.
export_error_host_unavailable: The task host could not be reached. Reconnect it and export again to include its conversation.
export_error_plugin_off: The plugin serving this task is off. Turn it on and export again to include its conversation.
export_error_attachment_missing: This saved image or archived output is missing.
export_error_invalid_record: This conversation record could not be read by this version. Update Mannie and try again.
export_error_ipc: Mannie could not answer the export request. Try again.
export_document_incomplete: This folder is incomplete. The export did not finish.
export_document_active: This conversation was still running when captured. Unfinished parts contain only saved content.
